Welcome

Let's set up Hearth for your family.

This takes about three minutes. Everything you set up stays on this computer — Hearth doesn't send anything to a cloud, ever. You can change any of this later.

1

Add a child

Just a name and a rough age. You can add more later. Used to organize their devices and to suggest sensible defaults.

2

Find their devices

Hearth will look at the devices on your home network. You'll match each one to a child. We found 4 devices already.

3

Set a starting policy

Pick from a few simple defaults — "Young child", "Tween", "Teen" — or skip and set it yourself. You can adjust everything later.

Local-only

Nothing is sent off this computer. No accounts, no cloud sync.

You can change anything

Pause, delete history, or remove a child at any time.

Skip ahead

You can leave a step for later — Hearth will keep reminding you in the corner.
